article.title: Manner of computing profits and gains of business or profession.
article.content:
27Manner of computing profits and gains of business or profession.

Section 27  ·  Chapter IV  ·  D.—Profits and gains of business or profession  ·  page 42 of the Act
The income referred to in section 26 shall be computed as per the provisions of sections 28 to 60, except section 58.
